title: A policy admits every row
explanation: USING of this permissive policy is the constant true, so it admits every row for SELECT, for anon, authenticated. Permissive policies are combined with OR: a stricter policy on the same table does not narrow this one. If every row really is meant to be reachable, keep it and set the expectation to "all"; otherwise replace true with the condition that ties a row to its user or tenant.
